test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT pair of a famous minaret and its construction year in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Char Minar-1664 CE**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Charminar **is a monument **located in Hyderabad, Telangana.**
 
• The monument was** built in 1591** by Muḥammad Qulī Quṭb Shah, the fifth king of the Quṭb Shāhī dynasty
 
• It is one of the **oldest monuments** in Hyderabad, with a history spanning over **425 years**.
 
• It was the **first multi-storied building** in the city.
 
• Its architectural design **draws inspiration from the Shia “tazias,**” which were built in memory of Hussain.
 
• Hence the pair **Char Minar–1664 CE is incorrect**
